claim: estimate.response.intervention_gcomp known-truth conformance for a hard do() intervention under a deterministic linear structural mean

estimator_contract.estimator: response.intervention_gcomp: additive-GAM outcome-nuisance fit on the adjustment set, then exact discrete g-computation of the mean outcome under the do(T=0.25) intervention (no Monte Carlo needed for a Set intervention)
estimator_contract.claim: point identification under backdoor adjustment on Z; the fixture pins the true intervention response computed analytically from the same deterministic Z sequence the Rust test generates, not an external oracle
estimator_contract.not_claimed: this is not a bitwise-identity claim against the additive-GAM basis; nuisance_lambda regularization can bias a penalized fit away from an exact linear recovery even with zero outcome noise, hence a statistical tolerance

tolerance.note: Regularized additive-GAM outcome nuisance biases the zero-noise linear recovery by ~0.016 at n=240; 0.05 is 3x observed error for platform headroom.

generation.note: z_i = sin(i/17), t_i = z_i + cos(i/11) (i=0..n), y_i = 1 + 2*t_i + 0.8*z_i exactly (zero outcome noise). true_response = 1 + 2*0.25 + 0.8*mean(z) computed from the exact same closed-form z sequence; no RNG or external implementation is involved.

oracle.method: zero-noise linear law: E[Y | do(T=0.25)] = 1 + 2*0.25 + 0.8*mean(z) over the fixed deterministic sequence (see `generation`)
asserted_outputs: tolerance.truth_absolute positivity (the band itself is a declared statistical tolerance)
context_only_outputs: tolerance note about the GAM penalty
oracle.independence_basis: The generator evaluates the structural mean at the stated dose and the stated deterministic z sequence in floating-point arithmetic; it imports no Antecedent code and no statistics package. The shared object is the structural-mean formula in the fixture contract.
oracle.historical_exposure: The original values were pinned in an earlier import whose harness was not retained; this reference was written during this review from the fixture formula and declared inputs, with the executing assertion read to establish which values it compares and no product implementation source consulted. Who first derived the pinned numbers is unrecorded.
